request.query: unbounded subset real numbers admits sequence with prescribed growth

items.name: tendsto_atTop_of_geom_le
items.type: ∀ {v : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℝ}, 0 < v 0 → 1 < c → (∀ (n : ℕ), c * v n ≤ v (n + 1)) → Filter.Tendsto v Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

items.name: Set.Unbounded
items.type: {α : Type u} → (α → α → Prop) → Set α → Prop

items.name: Set.Unbounded.mono
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {r : α → α → Prop} {s t : Set α}, s ⊆ t → Set.Unbounded r s → Set.Unbounded r t

items.name: ExpGrowth.expGrowthInf_le_expGrowthSup
items.type: ∀ {u : ℕ → ENNReal}, ExpGrowth.expGrowthInf u ≤ ExpGrowth.expGrowthSup u

items.name: ExpGrowth.expGrowthSup_le_iff
items.type: ∀ {u : ℕ → ENNReal} {a : EReal}, ExpGrowth.expGrowthSup u ≤ a ↔ ∀ b > a, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, u n ≤ (b * ↑n).exp

items.name: Frequently.le_linearGrowthSup
items.type: ∀ {u : ℕ → EReal} {a : EReal}, (∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, a * ↑n ≤ u n) → a ≤ LinearGrowth.linearGrowthSup u
